title: Canonical derived pullback identification of the structure sheaf
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with derived pullback $Lf^*$ [def-pc-derived-pullback] and the shared derived tensor structures [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. Use the canonical pullback tensor comparison fixed on K-flat representatives [def-pc-derived-pullback-tensor-comparison] and its monoidal realization [lem-pc-canonical-pullback-tensor-monoidal-realization]. Define the unit identification $Lf^*(\mathcal O_S[0])\simeq\mathcal O_X[0]$ to be the inverse of the unit isomorphism of this monoidal realization. Its tensorator is the fixed canonical comparison, so its unit laws determine this unit map; no arbitrary identification of line objects is selected.
